quests.quest_title: [CC] Are there any gaps in sidewalk coverage along this segment?
quests.quest_description: Indicate whether there are any missing sections, discontinuities, or areas where the sidewalk abruptly ends or is interrupted.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What is the sidewalk surface defect?
quests.quest_description: Select the condition issues that best describe this sidewalk surface.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What is the surface material of this sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: Select the primary surface material that makes up this sidewalk.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What is the width of this sidewalk (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Estimate or measure the clear, usable walking width of the sidewalk

quests.quest_title: [AP][ADA][CtT] Is there a clear, continuous 3 feet wide accessible pathway present?
quests.quest_description: Determine if there is an unobstructed, stable, and continuous path at least 3 feet (36 inches) wide along the entire sidewalk segment.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Is there a buffer between this sidewalk and motor vehicle travel lanes?
quests.quest_description: Indicate whether a physical separation (such as landscaping, curb space, parking space, bike lane, or other buffer) exists between the sidewalk and adjacent motor vehicle travel lanes.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What type of buffer is between this sidewalk and motor vehicle travel lanes?
quests.quest_description: Select the type of buffer separating the sidewalk from adjacent motor vehicle lanes.

quests.quest_title: [AP][CtT] What is the total width of the buffer between the sidewalk and motor vehicle travel lanes (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Estimate or measure the width of the buffer separating the sidewalk from adjacent motor vehicle lanes.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Is there a noticeable slope present on this sidewalk segment?
quests.quest_description: Indicate whether there is a visible or perceptible incline along or across this sidewalk segment that may affect walking or rolling.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What type of slope is present on this sidewalk segment?
quests.quest_description: Identify whether this sidewalk has a noticeable running slope (along the direction of travel) or cross slope (across the walking surface).

quests.quest_title: [CC] How would you rate the level of motor vehicle traffic on this street?
quests.quest_description: Rate the typical amount of motor vehicle traffic along this street on a scale of 1-5, where 1 indicates very low traffic and 5 indicates very heavy traffic.

quests.quest_title: [CtT] How safe do you feel using this segment of sidewalk?
quests.quest_description: On a scale of 1-5, where 5 is very safe and 1 is not safe at all, how safe do you feel walking on this pathway?

quests.quest_title: [CtT] What is contributing to your sense of safety?
quests.quest_description: Assess the overall sense of comfort for pedestrians at this crossing. Consider factors such as vehicle speed, exposure, visibility, and pedestrian infrastructure.

quests.quest_title: Take a picture of the sidewalk.
quests.quest_description: Capture a clear photo of the sidewalk surface.

quest_answer_choices.choice_follow_up: Please take a picture of the sidewalk.

quests.quest_title: [AP][CtT] What is your comfort level when making this crossing?
quests.quest_description: Indicate whether this pedestrian crossing feels comfortable or uncomfortable to use, considering factors such as vehicle behavior, visibility, and available pedestrian infrastructure.

quests.quest_title: [AP][CtT] Why does this crossing feel uncomfortable to you?
quests.quest_description: Assess the overall sense of comfort for pedestrians at this crossing. Consider factors such as vehicle speed, exposure, visibility, and pedestrian infrastructure.

quests.quest_title: [AP][CtT] Please share more detail about why this crossing feels uncomfortable.
quests.quest_description: Use this space to elaborate on the reasons selected above, or add any other details about what makes this crossing feel uncomfortable.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What is the total number of motor vehicle travel lanes on the street being crossed?
quests.quest_description: Enter the total number of motor vehicle travel lanes in both directions.

quests.quest_title: [AP][ADA][CtT][S&R][TRF] In your opinion, is there adequate lighting at this crossing? (1 = very low and 5 = well lit)
quests.quest_description: Rate how well-lit this crossing appears, considering visibility and lighting conditions.

quests.quest_title: Why did you rate the lighting at this crossing this way?
quests.quest_description: Briefly explain what you observed (e.g., broken or missing streetlights, distance between lights, ambient lighting from nearby buildings) that led to your lighting rating.

quests.quest_title: [AP][CtT] Is there an accessible pathway to this crosswalk?
quests.quest_description: Determine whether there is an accessible, continuous connection from stop to nearest crossing across a full block.

quests.quest_title: [CtT][S&R] Is the crossing controlled/signalized?
quests.quest_description: Indicate whether the pedestrian crossing is governed by active traffic control devices.

quests.quest_title: [CtT][S&R] What kind of signal/beacon is present at this crossing?
quests.quest_description: Select the type of pedestrian or traffic control present at this crossing. Include any pedestrian-specific signals or beacons if applicable.

quests.quest_title: [ADA][AP][CtT][S&R] In your opinion, does the signal provide enough time to cross?
quests.quest_description: Based on a normal walking pace, evaluate if the Walk and flashing Don't Walk intervals are sufficient.

quests.quest_title: [ADA][AP][CtT][S&R] Why do you feel the signal does or does not provide enough time to cross?
quests.quest_description: Briefly explain your observation (e.g., you had to hurry or run, the signal changed while you were still in the crosswalk, plenty of time was given).

quests.quest_title: [ADA][AP][CtT][S&R] Is there a lead pedestrian interval (LPI) at this crossing?
quests.quest_description: Does the pedestrian Walk signal turn on a few seconds before the vehicle traffic light turns green?

quests.quest_title: [CtT] Is there a painted crosswalk present?
quests.quest_description: Indicate if there are any painted lines on the road surface defining the crossing area.

quests.quest_title: [CtT] How would you rate the condition of the crosswalk?
quests.quest_description: Rate the physical condition of the paint (1 = hardly visible/faded, 5 = freshly painted/bright).

quests.quest_title: [CtT] Is there a median or median island present in the crossing?
quests.quest_description: A refuge island in the middle of the road that allows pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

quests.quest_title: [CtT][S&R] Is there a curb bulb at this crossing?
quests.quest_description: A sidewalk extension that narrows the street and increases pedestrian visibility.

quests.quest_title: [AP][CtT] How well do you feel seen by motor vehicle drivers when you're in this crossing?
quests.quest_description: Rate your perception of driver awareness and visibility (1 = hardly seen, 5 = very well seen)

quests.quest_title: [AP][CtT] Why do you feel this way about driver visibility at this crossing?
quests.quest_description: Briefly explain what made you feel seen or unseen by drivers (e.g., sightline obstructions, vehicle speed, lack of eye contact, crossing distance).

quests.quest_title: [CtT][TRF] Are there bike lanes or cycletracks on the roadway being crossed?
quests.quest_description: Check if the street you are crossing contains designated space for bicycles.

quests.quest_title: Take a picture of the crossing.
quests.quest_description: Capture a clear photo of the crossing.

quest_answer_choices.choice_follow_up: Please take a picture of the crossing.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Does this bus stop have a shelter?
quests.quest_description: Identify the presence of a shelter at this bus stop.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What type of shelter is present at this bus stop?
quests.quest_description: Identify the type of shelter structure at this bus stop.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Is there a shelter footing here (without a shelter)?
quests.quest_description: Check whether a shelter footing or foundation pad is present at this bus stop, if a shelter structure has not been installed.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Does this bus stop have seating?
quests.quest_description: Indicate whether any seating is available at this bus stop.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What type of seating is available at this bus stop?
quests.quest_description: Select the type of seating provided at this bus stop.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Does this bus stop have an LED schedule with real-time information?
quests.quest_description: Identify whether there is an LED or digital display providing real-time bus arrival or schedule information at this stop.

quests.quest_title: [TRF][ADA][CtT] In your opinion, is there adequate lighting at this bus stop? (1 = very low and 5 = well lit)
quests.quest_description: This bus stop feels well-lit and visible, especially in the evening or early morning.

quests.quest_title: [TRF][ADA][CtT] Why did you rate the lighting at this bus stop this way?
quests.quest_description: Briefly explain what you observed (e.g., broken or missing streetlights, distance between lights, ambient lighting from nearby buildings) that led to your lighting rating.

quests.quest_title: [CtT][S&R][TRF] What is the posted speed limit near this bus stop?
quests.quest_description: Enter the posted speed limit near this bus stop in miles per hour (mph)

quests.quest_title: [CC] Is there a pedestrian connection to this bus stop?
quests.quest_description: Indicate whether any pedestrian infrastructure connects this bus stop to the surrounding network.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What type of pedestrian infrastructure connects to this bus stop?
quests.quest_description: Identify the type of pedestrian infrastructure providing access.

quests.quest_title: [TRF][AP][CtT] What is the width of the pedestrian connection (in feet)?
quests.quest_description: Measure or estimate the width of the sidewalk or path connecting to the bus stop at its narrowest point.

quests.quest_title: [TRF][AP][CtT] How would you rate the quality of this pedestrian connection?
quests.quest_description: Rate the physical condition of the path. 1 = Poor (major cracks, overgrown, or obstructed); 5 = Excellent (smooth, clear, and well-maintained).

quests.quest_title: [CtT][TRF] Is there designated bicycle infrastructure within a block of this bus stop?
quests.quest_description: Identify whether there is dedicated bicycle infrastructure such as lanes, tracks, parking, or paths within a block of the bus stop that support multimodal access.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What type of infrastructure connects this bus stop to the bicycle network?
quests.quest_description: Determine what kind of bicycle infrastructure (if any) provides access between the bus stop and the nearby bike network.

quests.quest_title: [CtT][S&R] How would you rate the level of motor vehicle traffic within a block of this bus stop?
quests.quest_description: Rate the typical amount of motor vehicle traffic within a block of this bus stop on a scale of 1-5, where 1 indicates very low traffic and 5 indicates very heavy traffic.

quests.quest_title: [TRF][ADA][AP][CtT] Is there a clear, continuous 3 feet wide accessible pathway present from an intersection to the bus stop?
quests.quest_description: Determine if there is an unobstructed, stable, and continuous path at least 3 feet (36 inches) wide from an intersection to the bus stop.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Is there a pathway leading to this stop from the sidewalk centerline?
quests.quest_description: Indicate whether a defined pathway connects the sidewalk centerline to the bus stop boarding area, providing a continuous and accessible route for pedestrians.

quests.quest_title: [CtT] Is there a designated street crossing within a block of this stop?
quests.quest_description: Check if there is a marked crosswalk or signalized intersection within roughly 300 feet of the stop.

quests.quest_title: [CtT] What kind of street crossing is within a block of this stop?
quests.quest_description: Identify the primary type of crossing available for riders to reach the stop.

quests.quest_title: Take a picture of the bus stop.
quests.quest_description: Capture a clear photo of the bus stop.

quest_answer_choices.choice_follow_up: Please take a picture of the bus stop.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Is there a signal present at this intersection?
quests.quest_description: Select the type of pedestrian or traffic control present at this intersection. Include any pedestrian-specific signals or beacons if applicable.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: Yes, Unsignalled Intersection with Painted Crosswalk

quests.quest_title: [CtT][S&R] What is the posted speed limit on this roadway?
quests.quest_description: Enter the posted speed limit for the intersecting roadway in miles per hour (mph)

quests.quest_title: [CC] What is the total number of motor vehicle travel lanes on this street?
quests.quest_description: Enter the total number of motor vehicle travel lanes in both directions.

quests.quest_title: [CtT][S&R][TRF] Are there dedicated right and left turn lanes at the intersection?
quests.quest_description: Identify if there are lanes specifically reserved for turning movements, separate from lanes that allow through-traffic.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: Both left and right turn lanes

quests.quest_title: Take a picture of the intersection.
quests.quest_description: Capture a clear photo of the intersection.

quest_answer_choices.choice_follow_up: Please take a picture of the intersection.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What type of curb is this?
quests.quest_description: Identify the type of curb here.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What type of lowered curb is this?
quests.quest_description: Identify if this is a curb ramp or blended transition.

quests.quest_title: [ADA][CtT] Does this curb ramp directionally align with the crosswalk?
quests.quest_description: Check if this curb ramp lines up with the pedestrian crossing.

quests.quest_title: [CC] Does this curb ramp have edge protection?
quests.quest_description: Check if there is a vertical barrier to prevent falls.

quests.quest_title: [CC] What is the surface material of this curb ramp?
quests.quest_description: Identify the material this curb ramp is made of.

quests.quest_title: [ADA][CtT] Are detectable warnings (truncated domes) present?
quests.quest_description: Check for a tactile surface of raised domes at the base of the ramp. These are usually yellow or a contrasting color.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: Yes, with high color contrast (e.g. yellow on grey)

quests.quest_title: [ADA][CtT] Is there a level landing area (at least 3' x 3') at the top of the ramp?
quests.quest_description: Determine if there is a flat, unobstructed space at the top of the ramp to allow for turning.

quest_answer_choices.choice_text: No, landing is obstructed (e.g. by a pole/fire hydrant)

quests.quest_description: Capture a clear photo of the curb.

quest_answer_choices.choice_follow_up: Please take a picture of the curb.
